from.place: Existence clause of the identity-extension unit map.

title: Existence of the identity scalar-extension unit map
statement:
theorem adicUnit_exists_data (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A]
    (φ : A →+* A) (hφ : φ = RingHom.id A)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{t + 1} (adicModuleRing X A)) ℤ) :
    ∃ f : adicChange X φ P ⟶ P, IsIso f ∧
      ∀ (p : ℤ) (U : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (s : (adicConstantRing X A).obj.obj U)
        (m : (P.X p).val.obj U),
        (f.f p).val.app U (adicTensorSection X φ _ U s m) = s • m

proof.text: Construct the sheafified scalar-extension map that sends each local tensor generator s tensor m to s times m, construct its inverse by m ↦ 1 tensor m, and verify restriction and differential compatibility. Tensor induction proves both composites are identities, yielding an isomorphism and the displayed generator formula.
